_comment: Hoenn & Seek 2.0 part 12: secret base spots at the reopened legendary sites.
tools/hoenn/gen_hoenn_base_spots.py writes each spot's closed entrance metatile into the
layout (collision 1, elevation 0, like Emerald's own spots) and adds a secret_base bg event.
x,y is the wall tile; the player stands on the tile below it, facing up, and uses Secret Power.
id: the base's group (which interior you get) and a free variant (Emerald uses 1-4, so 9 is
always free). The indent colour should match the group (red/blue/yellow cave).
Constants go to include/constants/hoenn_secret_bases.h. Re-runs are idempotent.
